purpose: Exercises swaggo/swag-style doc-comment annotation parsing (docs/adr/0012-swag-annotation-evidence.md): a fully-annotated handler, a handler with a deliberately stale @Router line, and a handler with an ordinary prose-only doc comment that must not misfire.

expectedRoutes.note: GetUser: swag Summary/Description/Tags/Deprecated all populated; @Router agrees with the discovered route, no diagnostic
ListUsers: swag Summary populated; @Router claims POST /users, a stale annotation vs the discovered GET /users — must produce swag-router-mismatch without suppressing Summary
PlainHandler: ordinary prose doc comment, no swag directive at all; route.Swag must be nil

expectedDiagnostics.note: ListUsers' @Router [post] disagrees with the discovered GET method
